Problem Statement:
DynamoDb2.client.transact_write_items transactions on same item
transact_write_items does not allow several transactions on the same item

https://boto3.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/services/dynamodb.html#DynamoDB.Client.transact_write_items
> TransactWriteItems is a synchronous write operation that groups up to 25 action requests. These actions can target items in different tables, but not in different Amazon Web Services accounts or Regions, and no two actions can target the same item

moto should also fail the transaction in this case (currently one can perform two transactions on the same item)

entries.content: Fixed. Root cause: `DynamoDBBackend.transact_write_items` never validated that multiple write actions target the same item. I added a pre-check that computes each write action's target (table name + hash/range key extracted via the table's key schema) and raises a `MockValidationException` ("Transaction request cannot include multiple operations on one item") on duplicates; ConditionCheck actions are excluded since AWS permits a ConditionCheck alongside a write on the same item (as existing tests require). `responses.transact_write_items` now maps that exception to a `ValidationException` error response. All 363 dynamodb2 tests pass.
